title: Low-Poly 3D — An idea connects.

scenes.title: Faceted idea becomes a network
scenes.purpose: Show one faceted core idea lighting up on a dusk-teal low-poly highland, then linking to four smaller faceted forms into a connected system.
visuals: Three.js flat-shaded low-poly terrain plateau in warm terracotta facets on cool teal-moss ground
Fogged faceted cone mountains and cone trees
Icosahedron core gem on a hexagonal stone pedestal with contact skirt and cast shadow
Five hexagonal faceted beams growing gem surface to gem surface with an amber tip spark
Dark translucent 2D copy card on the left

beats.development: Camera begins a slow push-in; the core gem rises out of its pedestal with a back-out scale, catching the warm key light; the copy card fades in and its headline follows after the card is complete.
Five links grow one after another from the core to four pedestal gems; each gem pops in as its first link arrives and flares briefly; the rule and subline reveal.
captions: One faceted core, five linked forms.

beats.development: Network settles: flares decay to embers, the camera push eases to rest by 2.5 s, and the full composition holds legibly.
captions: One faceted core, five linked forms.

findings: Core emergence is the first focus; links follow in a readable travelling order rather than all at once.
All copy fully legible from about 1.5 s; geometry settled by 2.5 s, before the 2.7 s requirement.
justifiedHolds: 1.85–3.0 s hold lets the viewer read the full headline and see the completed network.

notes: No reviewed preview recipe was supplied (STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes); the refresh demonstrates the BACKGROUND_REVIEW source-frame lessons with a scene-dependent dusk-teal palette instead of the prior cream swatch.
